allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== 常见 Node 安装路径检查 ==="; $paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\nodejs\\node.exe", "${env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)}\\nodejs\\node.exe", "$env:APPDATA\\npm\\node.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\nodejs\\node.exe"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { Write-Output "找到: $p" } }; Write-Output "`n=== nvm-windows 检查 ==="; if \(Get-Command nvm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { nvm list } else { Write-Output "未找到 nvm 命令" }; Write-Output "`n=== PATH 环境变量 ==="; $env:PATH -split ';' | Select-String -Pattern "node|npm")

PowerShell($items = Get-ChildItem -Force; if \($items.Count -eq 0\) { Write-Output "目录为空: 是 \(0 个文件/文件夹\)" } else { Write-Output "目录为空: 否，共 $\($items.Count\) 项"; $items | Format-Table Name, Mode, Length, LastWriteTime -AutoSize }; Write-Output "`n=== package.json 是否存在 ==="; Test-Path "package.json"; Write-Output "`n=== astro.config 是否存在 ==="; Test-Path "astro.config.mjs"; Test-Path "astro.config.ts"; Write-Output "`n=== .git 目录是否存在 ==="; Test-Path ".git")

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== 检查包管理器/安装工具可用性 ==="; foreach \($cmd in @\("winget","choco","scoop","fnm","volta"\)\) { if \(Get-Command $cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { Write-Output "$cmd : 可用" } else { Write-Output "$cmd : 不可用" } })

Bash(cd "/c/Users/USER/Desktop/rocketjichang.com" && echo "=== 实际生成的路由 ===" && find dist -name "index.html" | sed 's#dist##; s#/index.html##; s#^$#/#' | sort -u > /tmp/routes.txt && cat /tmp/routes.txt && echo "" && echo "=== 全站出现的站内链接\(去重\) ===" && grep -rohE 'href="/[^"]*"' dist/**/*.html dist/*.html 2>/dev/null | sed 's/href="//; s/"$//' | grep -v '_astro' | sort -u > /tmp/links.txt && cat /tmp/links.txt && echo "" && echo "=== 链接中不在路由表内的\(潜在死链，排除favicon\) ===" && comm -23 /tmp/links.txt /tmp/routes.txt | grep -v favicon)
